description_en: Queries the AI Engine overview data
description_zh: 查询 AI Engine 概览数据
name: DescribeAiEngineOverview

parameters.help_en: The region where the WAF instance resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF 实例的 ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前 WAF 实例的 ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The start time. The time is a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: seconds. Data is filtered based on the time when the event was last detected. You can query data within the last 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，格式为 Unix 时间戳（UTC 时间），单位为秒。按照事件最近发现时间筛选，支持查询最近 30 天内的数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The time is a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: seconds. Data is filtered based on the time when the event was last detected. The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，格式为 Unix 时间戳（UTC 时间），单位为秒。按照事件最近发现时间筛选，需晚于开始时间
parameters.name: end_time

AnalyzedRequestCount.title_en: 已分析的请求数；无统计数据时为 null。
AnalyzedRequestCount.title_zh: 已分析的请求数；无统计数据时为 null。

HandleStatusCounts.title_zh: 时间范围内按人工状态统计的事件数。
